basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully renovated home in San Francisco's highly desirable Outer Sunset district. The main level features a bright and inviting layout with 3 spacious bedrooms and 1 modern bathroom, complemented by a tastefully updated kitchen and comfortable living area perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The lower level offers incredible flexibility with 1 additional bedroom, 1 full bathroom, a living room with kitchen hookups, and a bonus flex roomideal for guests, extended family, or a potential home office setup. Sitting on a large lot, this home provides both indoor comfort and outdoor potential for gardening, play, or future expansion. Enjoy the best of coastal city living with close proximity to the Noriega, Lawton, Judah, and Irving Street corridors, Sunset Dunes Park, Ocean Beach, and multiple Muni lines for an easy commute. Move-in ready and thoughtfully designed, this home perfectly combines modern updates with the laid-back charm of the Sunset. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a versatile, stylish home in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods.
